name: Halogen-Qwen3.8-flash-next
docker_command:
docker run --rm -it --name ai-toolbox-cockpit-halogen-server-334446c6 \
  --pull=always \
  --device /dev/kfd \
  --device /dev/dri \
  --group-add video \
  --group-add $(getent group render | cut -d: -f3) \
  --security-opt seccomp=unconfined \
  --ipc=host \
  --ulimit memlock=-1:-1 \
  -p {bind}:{port}:{port} \
  --security-opt no-new-privileges \
  -v {models}/qwen38-flash-next-w4b.hgn:/models/qwen38-flash-next-w4b.hgn:ro \
  -v {models}/qwen38-flash-next-w4b.overlay-speed.hgn:/models/qwen38-flash-next-w4b.overlay-speed.hgn:ro \
  -v {models}/tokenizer/chat_template.jinja:/models/tokenizer/chat_template.jinja:ro \
  -v {models}/tokenizer/generation_config.json:/models/tokenizer/generation_config.json:ro \
  -v {models}/tokenizer/merges.txt:/models/tokenizer/merges.txt:ro \
  -v {models}/tokenizer/tokenizer.json:/models/tokenizer/tokenizer.json:ro \
  -v {models}/tokenizer/tokenizer_config.json:/models/tokenizer/tokenizer_config.json:ro \
  -v {models}/tokenizer/vocab.json:/models/tokenizer/vocab.json:ro \
  -v {models}/qwen38-flash-next-vision.hgn:/models/qwen38-flash-next-vision.hgn:ro \
  -e HALOGEN_CHECKPOINT=/models/qwen38-flash-next-w4b.hgn \
  -e HALOGEN_CK_OVERLAY=/models/qwen38-flash-next-w4b.overlay-speed.hgn \
  -e HALOGEN_TOKENIZER=/models/tokenizer \
  -e HALOGEN_API_PORT={port} \
  -e HALOGEN_CTX={ctx} \
  -e HALOGEN_KV_POOL_POSITIONS={kv_pool_positions} \
  -e HALOGEN_KV_SLOTS={kv_slots} \
  -e HALOGEN_PROMPT_CACHE={prompt_cache} \
  -e HALOGEN_VISION_TOWER=/models/qwen38-flash-next-vision.hgn \
  {image}
description: Run Strix Halo Halogen LLM Inference engine

name: GUFO-Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_XL
docker_command:
docker run --rm -it --name gufo-cockpit-server-5f134390 \
  --device /dev/dri \
  --device /dev/kfd \
  --group-add video \
  --group-add render \
  --security-opt seccomp=unconfined \
  --ipc=host \
  -p {bind}:{port}:{port} \
  -v {models}/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF/Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf:/models/target/Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf:ro \
  -v {models}/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2-GGUF:/models/speculation:ro \
  {image} gufo serve \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port {port} \
  --sessions {sessions} \
  llm \
  --model /models/target/Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf \
  --context {ctx} \
  --max-tokens {max_tokens} \
  --served-model-name {served_model_name} \
  --think {think} \
  --reasoning-effort {reasoning_effort} \
  --max-pending-per-client {max_pending_per_client} \
  --speculative dflash2 \
  --dflash-model /models/speculation/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2-Q4_K_M.gguf \
  --draft-tokens {draft_tokens}
description: Run GUFO LLM server (llama.cpp-style GGUF serving) on Strix Halo

  --metrics
description: Run ROCM 10 Llama.cpp server with Gemma 4 26B-A4B on Strix Halo

name: Halogen-Qwen3.8-flash-next-NPU-Prefill
docker_command:
docker run --rm -it --name {container_name} \
  --pull=always \
  --device /dev/kfd \
  --device /dev/dri \
  --device /dev/accel/accel0 \
  -v /sys:/host/sys \
  --group-add video \
  --group-add $(getent group render | cut -d: -f3) \
  --security-opt seccomp=unconfined \
  --ipc=host \
  --ulimit memlock=-1:-1 \
  -p {bind}:{port}:{port} \
  --security-opt no-new-privileges \
  -v {xrt_system_lib_dir}/libxrt_coreutil.so.2:/opt/xilinx/xrt/lib/libxrt_coreutil.so.2:ro \
  -v {xrt_system_lib_dir}/libxrt_core.so.2:/opt/xilinx/xrt/lib/libxrt_core.so.2:ro \
  -v {xrt_system_lib_dir}/libxrt_driver_xdna.so.2:/opt/xilinx/xrt/lib/libxrt_driver_xdna.so.2:ro \
  -v {xrt_system_lib_dir}/libxrt_coreutil.so.2:/opt/xilinx/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libxrt_coreutil.so.2:ro \
  -v {xrt_system_lib_dir}/libxrt_core.so.2:/opt/xilinx/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libxrt_core.so.2:ro \
  -v {xrt_system_lib_dir}/libxrt_driver_xdna.so.2:/opt/xilinx/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libxrt_driver_xdna.so.2:ro \
  -v {xrt_system_lib_dir}/libxrt_coreutil.so.2:/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libxrt_coreutil.so.2:ro \
  -v {xrt_system_lib_dir}/libxrt_core.so.2:/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libxrt_core.so.2:ro \
  -v {xrt_system_lib_dir}/libxrt_driver_xdna.so.2:/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libxrt_driver_xdna.so.2:ro \
  -v {models}/qwen38-flash-next-w4b.hgn:/models/qwen38-flash-next-w4b.hgn:ro \
  -v {models}/qwen38-flash-next-w4b.overlay-speed.hgn:/models/qwen38-flash-next-w4b.overlay-speed.hgn:ro \
  -v {models}/tokenizer/chat_template.jinja:/models/tokenizer/chat_template.jinja:ro \
  -v {models}/tokenizer/generation_config.json:/models/tokenizer/generation_config.json:ro \
  -v {models}/tokenizer/merges.txt:/models/tokenizer/merges.txt:ro \
  -v {models}/tokenizer/tokenizer.json:/models/tokenizer/tokenizer.json:ro \
  -v {models}/tokenizer/tokenizer_config.json:/models/tokenizer/tokenizer_config.json:ro \
  -v {models}/tokenizer/vocab.json:/models/tokenizer/vocab.json:ro \
  -v {models}/qwen38-flash-next-vision.hgn:/models/qwen38-flash-next-vision.hgn:ro \
  -v {models}/npu:/models/npu \
  -v {npu_model_dir}:/models/npu/wemm-embedding-4b:ro \
  -e HALOGEN_CHECKPOINT=/models/qwen38-flash-next-w4b.hgn \
  -e HALOGEN_CK_OVERLAY=/models/qwen38-flash-next-w4b.overlay-speed.hgn \
  -e HALOGEN_TOKENIZER=/models/tokenizer \
  -e HALOGEN_API_PORT={port} \
  -e HALOGEN_CTX={ctx} \
  -e HALOGEN_KV_POOL_POSITIONS={kv_pool_positions} \
  -e HALOGEN_KV_SLOTS={kv_slots} \
  -e HALOGEN_PROMPT_CACHE={prompt_cache} \
  -e HALOGEN_VISION_TOWER=/models/qwen38-flash-next-vision.hgn \
  -e HALOGEN_NPU_MODELS=wemm-embedding-4b \
  {image}
description: Halogen flash server with the image-pinned WeMM-Embedding-4B model on the XDNA 2 NPU. The model is mounted read-only at /models/npu/wemm-embedding-4b and selected by its registered model ID. Host XRT/XDNA libraries are mounted at the container XRT, Xilinx fallback, and system library paths. Host /sys lets Halogen hold the GPU fabric clock; the writable /models/npu cache contains the pinned decider-4b device files.
